source_post: 지치의 블로그를 빛내줄 개성 만점 캐릭터 4총사를 소개합니다!

jichi.visual_dna: A cute chubby 3D sprout fairy (28cm tall) with a lime-green rounded body and hood, a distinct HEART-SHAPED ivory-cream face mask framing the face, big sparkling dark-brown/olive eyes, pink blushing cheeks, a tiny brown nose, TWO large fresh green leaves sprouting from the very top center of the head, a green leaf-collar around the neck with a green leaf-shaped badge on the chest reading '지치', a round ivory-cream belly patch, and a tiny stubby green tail on the back. Strictly NO fairy wings on the back.

songi.visual_dna: A cute chubby 3D Korean shorthair calico cat (25cm tall) with soft fluffy white fur, a dark-black patch on the left ear/temple (viewer's left) and a warm orange-ginger patch on the right ear/temple (viewer's right) with a wide white forehead in between, big round dark-brown/amber eyes, a pink triangle nose with ONE tiny cute beauty mole dot right next to the nose, pink paw pads, and a fluffy black-and-orange striped tail.

choco.visual_dna: A cute chubby 3D black-and-white tuxedo cat with bright round eyes, white muzzle, white chest and paws.

ai_robot.visual_dna: A cute glossy white 3D mini robot with a black digital visor screen face showing glowing cyan smiling eyes.
